items.title: Florian J. "Curly" Lizana Interview, 1966-05-18
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] You knew the Shields boys? >> [INTERVIEWEE] Yeah, there's a Shields boy.

ctx.x: Yeah, there's a Shields boy. Who was the others? Sharky? The Sharky one of them? No, it was the Shields.
There was Larry and Eddie Shields, and I think one called Pat Shields. I never did know him. I only knew Harry and Larry.
